title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
summary: Additionally, YouTube has intensified its crackdown on low-quality AI content by clarifying monetization policies, so “inauthentic content” cannot be monetized, including generic, repetitive, or template-based content, and any content featuring AI personas discussing sensitive topics such as health and finance.
